titulo: Conjugate -cer and -cir verbs (c > zc) in the present subjunctive
subtitulo: Conozco → conozca: the zc of yo spreads to every form.
regla: Verbs in vowel + -cer / -cir that have zc in the yo present keep zc in every form of the present subjunctive: conozca, produzcamos.

bloques.texto: Many verbs ending in **-cer** or **-cir** after a vowel change **c** to **zc** in the present, but only in **yo** (**conozco**, **produzco**). In the present subjunctive they keep that **zc** in **every form**.

The endings are the regular **-er** / **-ir** subjunctive ones. In Mexico, to drive a car is **manejar** (**maneje**); **conducir** is used for hosting a show or in formal writing. Other verbs like this: **conducir**, **traducir**, **introducir**, **parecer**, **merecer**, **ofrecer**, **amanecer**, **crecer**.
Tip: the **z** that slipped into **yo** never leaves the house again.

lista.en: I don't think you know Beto.

lista.es: Espero que ==produzcamos== muchos jitomates este año.
lista.en: I hope we grow lots of tomatoes this year.

lista.es: Dice que ==introduzcan== la tarjeta en la máquina.
lista.en: It says to insert the card in the machine.

lista.es: Quieren que ==conduzca== el programa de radio.
lista.en: They want me to host the radio show.

lista.es: Me gusta que ahora ==amanezca== más temprano.
lista.en: I like that it gets light earlier now.
It's amazing how much they look alike.

filas.t: No creo que conoces a Naomi.
No creo que conozcas a Naomi.

lista.texto: The present, where only **yo** changes: [[5928|-cer / -cir: c > zc in yo]], [[5653|traducir and conducir]].
The base pattern: [[5151|-er and -ir in the subjunctive]].
When to use which: [[6865|saber and conocer]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: **Conocer** with **ustedes**: Quiero que ___ a mi familia.
lista.r: Quiero que conozcan a mi familia.

lista.p: **Traducir** with **tú**: Quiero que me ___ la carta.
lista.r: Quiero que me traduzcas la carta.

lista.p: **Traducir** with **nosotros**: Es mejor que ___ el texto.
lista.r: Es mejor que traduzcamos el texto.
